consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: We listen before we design. In a dedicated session, we explore your vision, lifestyle, and the architectural intent of your space to ensure every material choice is deliberate.

curation.title: Curation
curation.description: From our collections of 35+ series, we handpick surfaces that align with your aesthetic and structural requirements. Every recommendation is considered, never arbitrary.

fulfillment.title: Fulfillment
fulfillment.description: Expert craftsmen. Precise execution. Every joint and edge is placed with deliberate care. We treat your space with the same reverence as a master artisan treats their medium.

aftercare.title: Aftercare
aftercare.description: Our relationship does not end at handover. We provide documentation, care guidance, and a guarantee on every installed surface so your investment remains protected.

minh-chau.quote: Perla transformed our penthouse from a construction site into a sanctuary. Every tile, every joint was executed with precision.

tran-quoc-hung.quote: We engaged Hung Phat for our boutique hotel lobby. The Travertine collection they curated was perfect, and guests comment on it daily.

nguyen-lan-anh.quote: Working with a ceramics partner who truly understands interior intent is rare. Hung Phat exceeded our architectural specification.
